A mercenary belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. His rank is sergeant (later promoted to master sergeant), callsign $$ウルズ$$ 6.
He is an $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) operative aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and a top-class genius sniper. His marksmanship is such that he can shoot a coin from a kilometer away.
A handsome young man with blond hair and blue eyes, he has even worked as a fashion magazine model. However, he talks too much, and is a playboy who flirts with any woman he sees. He is constantly needling $$マオ$$ as well, though it is unclear how serious he really is.
Incidentally, he lived in Edogawa, Tokyo until he was 14, and speaks fluent Japanese.
He is dispatched to Japan along with $$宗介$$ and $$マオ$$ on the mission to guard $$千鳥かなめ$$. From then on, he fights alongside $$宗介$$ against a variety of enemies.
In the course of the fighting, he and $$マオ$$ are drawn to each other, and in time become lovers.
When he is set against $$カスパー$$, his sniping teacher, he loses in an AS-versus-AS sniping duel. Though wounded, he shoots $$カスパー$$ through even in that state with an ultra-long-range shot so extraordinary it could be called divine skill, saving $$宗介$$, but after that his fate is unknown.
Everyone mourns his death, but he is in fact alive, and during the final battle he dramatically rescues $$マオ$$ when she falls into peril. Since $$クルツ$$'s death had raised morale in $$ミスリル$$, the $$マオ$$ he loves tells him he has 'ruined it,' though inwardly she was glad of his return.
fixes.reason: omitted subject: 内心では喜ばれていた follows 愛するマオからは...言われる, so the entry settles that Mao is the one inwardly glad; the passive left the subject open

fixes.new:
Belongs to the operations department of $$ミスリル$$'s West Pacific fleet, the anti-terrorist organization. His rank is major.
Aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, he is the operations commander who acts as $$テッサ$$'s right hand, directing the ground forces.
He is always calm and collected, and does not hesitate to make ruthless decisions when the mission demands it. Yet he is also a man of loyalty and deep feeling, and $$テッサ$$ and his subordinates place absolute trust in him.
He once served as a commanding officer in the special forces of a certain country, but was driven from his homeland after being caught up in a conspiracy, and was saved by guerrillas he had once fought as an enemy. He is an acquaintance of $$宗介$$ from that time, and the two have since survived countless brushes with death together.
He had a wife who was a violinist. She, too, was in favor of the plan to adopt $$宗介$$ and live together as a family, but she died along with the child in her womb because of a medical error during childbirth.
After $$ミスリル$$ is reduced to ruins by $$アマルガム$$, he defects to $$アマルガム$$ for his own purposes and, as 'Mr. K (Potassium),' turns against $$宗介$$ and his former comrades.
His aim was to correct history through $$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$ and create a gentle world in which his wife, who died of a medical error, is alive.
In the final battle on $$メリダ島$$, he shoots dead $$レナード$$, who tried to blow up $$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$ after being defeated, and tries to carry off $$かなめ$$ in order to continue the plan, but $$宗介$$ stands in the way. He fights $$宗介$$, who wants a resolution, in a fight on foot without any AS, passes on the words that $$宗介$$'s mother entrusted to him at the very end, and breathes his last.
To $$宗介$$, he was a 'dad' even though they were not related by blood.
fixes.reason: addition: 生身の戦い means a fight in the flesh, i.e. outside an AS; the Japanese does not say bare-handed (素手)
